body:
One commit per issue. A Haiku agent wrote each commit in its own worktree. A separate verifier then re-ran the gates under the repo's pinned `pre-commit` hooks and mutation-checked the new tests, sending findings back for fix rounds until it passed.

**Merge with rebase, not squash.** The commits have different types and scopes, and release-please reads each one only under rebase or merge-commit. A squash would apply a single type to every package the PR touches.

## Commits

| Commit | Change | Issue |
|---|---|---|
| `fix(session-plugin)` | Two bugs, both reproduced on main. (1) A failed Discussions GraphQL call could rename the top-level `GH_FAIL_REASON`: a list-call `api-error` came out as `auth`. (2) The query also ran under `--summary`, so every SessionStart nudge spent one GraphQL call whose output it never printed. `GH_FAIL_REASON`/`GH_FAIL_DETAIL` now come from the list calls only, and the query is skipped in summary mode. | Refs #2569 |
| `docs(comfyui-plugin)` | `pitfalls.md`, `registry-readiness.md` and comfy-registry-lifecycle now say a Deleted version is expected to fall back like Banned, keeping the "not yet verified against `/install`" hedge. A doc-pin case in `test-registry-health.sh` requires every fall-back claim that names Banned to also name Deleted. Also adds `test-skill-scripts.yml` path filters for those docs and for `scaffold.py`. | Refs #2994 |
| `feat(workflow-orchestration-plugin)` | `workflow-scale-budget/scripts/workflow-run-tally.sh` reports a finished Workflow run's agents and token totals from its local transcripts. A session id gives every run in the session plus a session total. Usage is deduplicated per message id, keeping the last line, because summing the raw lines overstates cache tokens about 2×. A run that ended with started agents and no result for them is a WARN. | Refs #2783, #2670 |
| `fix(scripts)` | `workflow-run-cost.sh` used to sample runs by their conclusion. A run whose Claude job or step was skipped by its own `if:` therefore took a `--limit` slot and reported `COST_USD=unknown`, and the obsidian-cli-changelog sample had no costed run at all. Each run is now classified from its job list, and the walk is bounded by `--scan`. The script reports `RUNS_SCANNED`, `GATED_OFF_RUNS` and `SCAN_TRUNCATED`. A log check acts as a backstop: a run whose log carries the action's accounting is always sampled. The audit prompt now treats `SCAN_TRUNCATED=true` totals as a lower bound. | Refs #2669 |
| `docs(workflow-orchestration-plugin)` | Agentic Optimizations table for `workflow-run-tally.sh`, as the skill-quality reviewer suggested. | Refs #2783 |
| `feat(git-plugin)` | A no-force stacked-merge path in git-merge-hazards (`references/no-force-push-stack.md`). It records the pre-squash tip and the squash commit before the base merges, and re-reads the child after retargeting. It then classifies by `rev-list --count squash..origin/main`. **Case A** (main has not moved past the squash) uses `update-branch`, or a `-X ours` merge in a worktree. **Case B** uses the pre-squash-tip route. Every route pushes by SHA without force. The empty-diff gates compare tree SHAs (`rev-parse '^{tree}'`, `write-tree`), so a committed `.gitmodules` with `ignore = all`, or any diff setting, cannot make a changed tree read as empty. In `stacked-chain-push.md`, the check-count gate is replaced by a `statusCheckRollup` completion gate with a `headRefOid` == pushed-SHA check and two reads ~30 s apart. Also adds a base-state precondition in SKILL.md §2, and `sync-notes.md` lists the sections that diverge from the chezmoi rule. | Closes #2826 |

## Known minor items left as is

These are from the last verification round of #2826. None is blocking.

- Scenario SM Case B asserts only that the run stops. Because step 4 also stops it, its step-2 tree gate is covered only by the structural `tree_gates_pinned` pin.
- Some prose in `no-force-push-stack.md` is wrapped unevenly.
- The `diff.trustExitCode` case has no behavioural test: the sandbox git is 2.43, so it is pinned structurally.
- `git-merge-hazards` §2/§3 now diverge from the chezmoi `pr-merge-hazards.md` rule outside this repo. `sync-notes.md` records which sections need mirroring there.

## Test plan

- [x] `pre-commit run --files <changed files>` (pinned hook versions) clean for every commit
- [x] `session-plugin/scripts/tests/test-session-survey.sh`: PASS=752 FAIL=0
- [x] `comfyui-node-scaffold/scripts/tests/test-registry-health.sh`: 51 passed
- [x] `workflow-scale-budget/scripts/tests/test-workflow-run-tally.sh`: PASS=122 FAIL=0
- [x] `scripts/tests/test-workflow-run-cost.sh`: 140 passed, new cases mutation-checked
- [x] `git-merge-hazards/scripts/tests/test-no-force-stack.sh`: 356 passed. Mutation-checked: tree gates, submodule/textconv flags, empty-baseline and Classify guards, `--no-ff`.
- [x] `git-merge-hazards/scripts/tests/test-push-refspec.sh`: 18 passed
- [x] CI green on `b3e10e0` (compliance, test, lint, validate, gate, conventional-commits)
